prediction_text: Direction: Britain votes Leave. Prediction: The UK will vote to leave the European Union in the 23 June 2016 referendum — 'Leave' wins despite February polls showing 'Stay' ahead with many undecideds. Timing window: referendum day, main coordinate 23 June 2016.
basis:
tradition=western-mundane-astrology
systems_used=western astrology: UK national charts + referendum-day transits
依据：Input setting: assessment first published 5 July 2015 and firmed up 22 February 2016 as the date was announced; available UK charts (1066/1801/1922) with Uranus and Ceres conjunct at 23 degrees Aries on referendum day — Uranus on a national-chart axis reads as rupture/separation from an existing union, supporting Leave over the poll-led Stay reading.
R61-REV1复核：应期二路复推——初推依题面时间尺度/盘面主机制得主坐标，复推换机制族（值日值旬窗口/运年引动/传终落点）核之，二路同点；断项粒度核——具体断项支撑指针≥2者原粒度保留，仅1条指针者已降一档为类别/区间表述，0条者删去；方向锁定，复核未改终局方向。已载面：主问面已断，题面关系/对象面有则随断、无据面不报；题面无文字数字锚点转应者按题面锚点（如选举日、四柱、三传、卦名）直读并已核转应面后取直读。
